name: El Celler de Can Roca
tier: THE BERTHS · THE STARRED LINE — GIRONA AND THE EMPORDÀ
recognition: MICHELIN 3 stars, Guide Spain & Andorra 2026 (one of 16 three-star houses) · 40 years in 2026
what_to_order: Festival menu|Forty-dish anniversary menu|Wine pairing|Oyster with albariño|Láctico
price_range: Call ahead: no 2026 price found; older press gives EUR 190-225 per person before drinks (undated, seen Oct 2026)
reservation: Online only, through the restaurant's website. Dates open up to 11 months ahead, released at midnight CET on the first day of each month; full dates take a waiting list. A credit card guarantees the booking; a no-show or a cancellation inside 10 days is charged per person. Tables for 2 to 12.
verdict: The grand night of the coast, for guests who will plan a trip around one dinner. Book the Festival menu with Josep Roca's wine pairing, and ask whether the fortieth-anniversary menu is being served on your date.
caveat: Expect full books for months ahead: plan the first-of-month release, not the trip, first. The 2026 price and the anniversary menu's price were not found. The menu is served to the whole table.
hot_this_month: The MICHELIN Spain 2027 stars are announced on 24 November in Huesca; book now rather than after (checked 19 Oct 2026).

name: Bo.TiC
tier: THE STARRED LINE — GIRONA AND THE EMPORDÀ
recognition: MICHELIN 2 stars (guide page 'Dos Estrellas'; 2026 two-star lists) · second star in the 2021 guide · La Liste 77 (2026)
what_to_order: Degustación menu|Del Chef menu|Arroz al cuadrado
price_range: Call ahead: an undated Salir listing gives EUR 190 (Degustación) and EUR 250 (Del Chef); 2026 prices not confirmed (seen Oct 2026)
reservation: Book ahead; one April 2026 diner reports an online booking with a EUR 200 deposit that was not refunded after cancelling, so read the cancellation terms
verdict: The quieter of the coast's two-star tables, for a long lunch inland from Palamós. Start with the Degustación menu; take the Del Chef menu only if the table wants the full afternoon.
caveat: Coordinate is approximate: sources disagree by about 1.4 km along the C-66, so check the building on arrival. Opening days and closing weeks were not found for 2026.

name: Els Tinars
address: Ctra. de Sant Feliu a Girona (C-65) km 7.2, 17240 Llagostera
tier: THE STARRED LINE — GIRONA AND THE EMPORDÀ
recognition: MICHELIN 1 star (current guide page; star since 2008 per 3Cat) · Premi Nacional de Gastronomia 2025, Marc Gascons
what_to_order: Palamós prawn tartare|Creamy rice with cod tripe, black butifarra and artichokes|Seasonal menu|Tasting menu
price_range: Seasonal menu EUR 59.50, EUR 69.50 with wines (Ara, Oct 2024); Time Out menus EUR 36-93, carte about EUR 60 (undated) (seen Oct 2026)
reservation: Book ahead, especially for weekend lunch
verdict: For guests who want serious Catalan cooking without a laboratory feel, at a fraction of the two- and three-star bills. Order the Palamós prawn tartare and the seasonal menu.
caveat: Opening days conflict between MICHELIN and Time Out, and 2026 prices were not found. It is a roadside house on the C-65, so plan a driver.

name: La Gamba
tier: THE BERTHS · THE PORT AND THE CATCH
recognition: Family restaurant on the Palamós port since the 1960s (old record: 1967) · Time Out Girona pick
what_to_order: Gamba de Palamós a la planxa|Chicken with lobster|Arròs negre|Rice dishes
price_range: EUR 50-90; prawns priced by market weight (seen Jun 2026)
reservation: Book for weekend lunch and in summer
verdict: For anyone who wants the gamba de Palamós a short walk from where it is landed, without a tasting menu around it. Order the grilled prawns first, then a rice; reviews in April 2026 were split, so judge on the prawn.
caveat: Two April 2026 reviews disagree sharply (one 'poor and expensive', one 'excellent value'). Gamba prices move with the auction and peak around Christmas. Barcelona.com lists a November closure.
hot_this_month: The gamba is coming in off the autumn boats, before the January trawl stop: order it simply grilled (checked 19 Oct 2026).

name: Rafa's
recognition: Opinionated About Dining Casual Europe: No. 442 (2024), No. 622 (2025)
what_to_order: Grilled red prawns of Roses|House anchovies with tomato bread|Espardenyes|Clams off the planxa
price_range: EUR 60-100+ per person, by weight (seen Jun 2026)
reservation: Essential: very few tables; book by phone
verdict: For guests who care about raw material more than room or ceremony. Ask what came in, start with the Roses red prawns and the anchovies, and let Rafa steer the rest; the bill depends on weight.
caveat: No menu and no prices on the wall: the bill follows the weight and the day's market. Opening days are not settled between sources, so phone first.
hot_this_month: On the list for the Roses Suquet de Peix days, 16-25 October 2026; it seats only a handful, so call before you go (checked 19 Oct 2026).

name: Cal Tet
address: Carrer de Santa Anna 38, 17258 L'Estartit (Torroella de Montgrí)
recognition: Hotel Marisqueria Cal Tet, family hotel and seafood kitchen · Gastroranking 8.0 from 721 opinions
what_to_order: Suquet de peix|Seafood rice|Grilled fish of the day
reservation: Walk-in most of the year; book in July and August
verdict: For a straightforward fish lunch after a morning at the Medes, without resort pricing. Order the suquet or a seafood rice; in August expect a full, noisy room.
caveat: The rooms upstairs draw complaints about size and parking, which does not touch the restaurant, but the dining room is loud and full in August. No current opening days found.

name: Casamar
tier: THE COVE, THE VILLAGE AND THE CAPE
recognition: Family house, 70th anniversary in 2026 (Ara) · MICHELIN star 2012 guide to about 2021; now listed in the MICHELIN selection
what_to_order: Rice dishes|Puffed rice and caviar|White asparagus with hollandaise|Aged pork rib|Artichokes with duck gizzards and poached quail eggs|Punta d'en Blanc menu
reservation: Book ahead in summer for a table with the bay view
verdict: For a sunset dinner over the bay with cooking more careful than the cove usually offers. Order from the rice section, or take the Punta d'en Blanc menu if the table wants a set run.
caveat: No 2026 closing date or current opening days were found, so phone before a late-autumn dinner. Some listings still show a MICHELIN star and 1 Sol Repsol; the chef says the star is gone.

name: Can Bonay
tier: THE COVE, THE VILLAGE AND THE CAPE
recognition: Family-run since 1936 (Wanderlog, Barceló guide) · Peratallada's oldest restaurant per reviewers
what_to_order: Oca amb naps|Game in season|House red and rosé
verdict: For a slow lunch on a day ashore in the medieval villages, not for a fine-dining night. Order the goose with turnips and the house wine.
caveat: No 2026-dated evidence that it still trades was found: phone before driving out. Some reviewers report uneven service. Coordinate is village-centre precision.

name: Compartir Cadaqués
address: Riera de Sant Vicenç s/n, 17488 Cadaqués
tier: THE COVE, THE VILLAGE AND THE CAPE
recognition: MICHELIN Guide selection, no star · 2 Soles Guía Repsol
what_to_order: Chef's sharing menu|Gazpacho with pesto|Empordà seafood rice|Tuna roll|Sea bass
price_range: Chef's menu about EUR 80 per person (Macarfi); Time Out range EUR 30-100 (seen Oct 2026)
reservation: Book ahead by phone or online; the menu is served to the whole table
verdict: For a long shared lunch with the whole table on one menu, and the closest the coast gets to the elBulli lineage at a fraction of the Barcelona bill. Go with an open mind on the menu and start with the gazpacho.
caveat: Opening days change through the year and no 2026 closing date was found: phone before an autumn visit. Reviews in March-April 2026 are mixed on the menu's value; service and the courtyard are praised.

name: Espai del Peix / Llotja de Palamós
address: Edifici de la Llotja, Moll Pesquer s/n, 17230 Palamós
tier: THE MARKET, THE AUCTION, THE SALT
recognition: Working Llotja de Palamós with Museu de la Pesca guided visits · Fira de la Gamba 2026
what_to_order: Guided auction visit|Gamba de Palamós|Show-cooking and tasting|Saturday cooking workshop
price_range: Auction visit EUR 3.50, free under 4 (seen 2025 listings, Oct 2026); workshops about EUR 20 (older listing)
reservation: Book the auction visit and workshops through the Museu de la Pesca or Espai del Peix
verdict: The best hour in Palamós for a chef or a curious guest: book the auction visit first, then eat the prawn on the port. Check dates before going, since visits run on set days rather than every weekday.
caveat: Visits run on announced dates only, and there is no auction at weekends or when the fleet stays in. The 2026 visit price was not found.
hot_this_month: The trawlers are working this autumn, before their winter stop (2 Jan-16 Feb in 2025): watch the weekday afternoon auction now (checked 19 Oct 2026).

name: Anxoves Solés
tier: THE BERTHS · THE MARKET, THE AUCTION, THE SALT
recognition: Solés salting house since 1888 · factory-museum opened for the 130th anniversary
what_to_order: Anchovy fillets in olive oil|Whole salted anchovies|Seitons (boquerones)|Museum ticket with tasting
price_range: Museum and tasting about EUR 6-8 by platform (seen Oct 2026); jars and tins priced individually
reservation: Walk-in for the shop; museum tickets online or at the door
verdict: The larder stop for anyone provisioning a galley or taking food home. Do the museum and tasting, then buy the fillets in oil and a jar of seitons.
caveat: Hours come from a third-party ticket site only. Under-10s must be with an adult in the museum.
hot_this_month: The anchovy festa is over (4 Oct 2026), but the salt-cured filets are sold all year: stock the galley here (checked 19 Oct 2026).

name: Mercat del Lleó
address: Plaça de Francesc Calvet i Rubalcaba, 17002 Girona
tier: THE MARKET, THE AUCTION, THE SALT
verdict: Go in the morning, before the counters thin out, and shop for the galley or a picnic: botifarra, Empordà cheese, autumn bolets. Pair it with coffee in the Old Town across the river.
caveat: No 2026-dated source found; hours differ between sources, so assume mornings only and treat Friday afternoon as unconfirmed. Not to be confused with the Mercat de la Lleona, the Saturday flea market.
hot_this_month: Autumn bolets on the stalls, and Girona's Fires de Sant Narcís run 23 Oct-1 Nov around the corner; it is the usual stage for the new-oil presentation in mid-December (checked 19 Oct 2026).

name: La Fábrica
tier: LE BAR — GIRONA'S CUP AND CONE
recognition: Opened March 2015 by Christian and Amber Meier · own roast via Espresso Mafia
what_to_order: Flat white|Single-origin filter|Cinnamon bun|Fruit bowl|Burrata salad
price_range: EUR 5-18 (seen Jun 2026); coffee about EUR 3-4 in an older review
reservation: Walk-in; expect a queue at weekends
verdict: Coffee first: a flat white or filter, then a cinnamon bun if the queue allows. For crew on a rest day, or anyone curious about Girona's cycling life.
caveat: No 2026-dated review or post found, so trading now is likely but unconfirmed. Some reviewers find the food pricey or slow; the coffee is the reason to go.

name: Rocambolesc
neighborhood: Girona · Santa Clara, by the Onyar
tier: LE BAR — GIRONA'S CUP AND CONE
recognition: Opinionated About Dining Cheap Eats Europe: No. 43 (2023), No. 34 (2024), No. 60 (2025)
verdict: The walk-in way to taste the Roca brothers' kitchen. Order the panet, warm ice-cream brioche, or a soft-serve with toppings; queues build on summer evenings.
caveat: Hours differ between listings (noon to 20:30 on weekdays in one, 10:30 to 23:00 in others), and one listing gives Carrer de les Hortes 6 instead of Santa Clara 50: check before you walk over. Nothing dated 2026 was found, and nothing says it closed.
